title: Encrypt a CMS envelope for a pure ML-KEM recipient
goal: Encrypt CMS for pure ML-KEM on non-Windows with the net11.0 Pkcs asset; composite CMS remains unsupported.

selectionNotes: Pure ML-KEM only. Experimental SYSLIB5006 composite CMS Decrypt throws PlatformNotSupportedException.
CBC does not authenticate content/sender; certificate loading does not validate trust.
Empty UKM differs from omitted; no older-target route.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Primary APIs require the .NET 11 framework contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build the declared .NET 11 target; the exact RC2 pin is evidence, not a minimum SDK.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical sample language mode, without preview syntax.

packages.name: System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs
packages.reason: Inspected and executed RC2 KEM recipient implementation; reconcile future artifacts deliberately.

providers: OpenSSL 3.5+ ML-KEM; require MLKem.IsSupported and reject Windows.
platforms: RC2: non-Windows only; Linux/OpenSSL 3.5.5 executed. Apple/browser/mobile unverified.
prerequisites: Console net11.0, C# 15.0, nullable/implicit usings enabled; import System.Security.Cryptography. Full functions and caller instructions are included offline.
Import System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs and System.Security.Cryptography.X509Certificates; supply a trusted pure ML-KEM recipient certificate and its matching privately held MLKem key.
constraints: Pure ML-KEM only; the experimental SYSLIB5006 composite CMS Decrypt overload throws PlatformNotSupportedException in RC2.
CMS AES-CBC confidentiality does not authenticate message content or sender; certificate loading does not validate trust.
Present-but-empty UKM differs from omitted UKM; no verified older-target Pkcs route.
No account, resource provisioning, persistent key store, authenticated protocol, FIPS certification or unverified older-target package route is claimed.
stabilityLimitations: RC2 proof only; GA and other platforms unverified.

sources.title: Canonical RC2 support and experimental boundaries

evidence.scope: Actual original previous-release comparison on Windows x64; not an equivalent newer algorithm or a served .NET 10 recipe.
Actual Linux x64/OpenSSL 3.5.5 round trips and rejection checks in a network-disabled authoring container. See output and recipe for exact claims.

humanProof.scope: Actual primitive and local ephemeral-certificate operations are automated. Peer authentication, production trust/PKI, external interoperability, unexecuted platforms and GA are not claimed.
